purpose: Turn an app-neutral Mini App manifest into a tested, packaged, deployed, migrated, smoke-tested, accepted, and recoverable app.

inputs.requirements: Product requirements or an existing canonical Spec slice with explicit scope and acceptance evidence
inputs.manifest: Mini App manifest conforming to the portable app contract
inputs.sourceRevision: Exact repository revision used for implementation and package generation
inputs.target: Explicit non-production target descriptor with isolated runtime and database
inputs.fixture: Synthetic tenant, principal, project, app binding, roles, and test data
inputs.capabilities: Optional provider and durable job capabilities declared by the manifest

invariants: Never use production customer data, credentials, databases, or runtime processes for acceptance.
Authenticate through the platform and derive tenant and principal identity from authenticated context.
Long-running work uses the platform worker_jobs and outbox authority.
Every migration and deployment receipt binds target identity, source revision, package digest, and outcome.
A completed stage is checkpointed before selecting the next dependency-ready stage.
A retryable external failure waits only the affected stage while independent stages continue.
Deployment, runtime health, acceptance, and production readiness remain separate states.

stages.gate: requirements have an authoritative source and a bounded app scope
the app slice is traceable to its source requirements and explicit non-goals
work scopes, dependencies, validation, and non-production constraints are explicit
all required fields and capability declarations are valid
generated paths are app-scoped and do not overwrite unrelated work
migration scope and rollback or recovery behavior are declared
actions enforce tenant, project, app, and principal permissions
required user journeys and accessibility-critical interactions are covered
provider absence or failure has a declared fallback or a scoped wait
jobs use worker_jobs/outbox and prove retry, idempotency, and recovery
focused unit, authorization, isolation, action, job, and UI checks pass
manifest and artifact validate and the digest is deterministic
deployment consumes the recorded artifact on an isolated non-production target
normal migration path records STARTED and SUCCEEDED for the declared target
authenticated API and required background behavior pass without production access
end-to-end user and equivalent headless journeys pass across required viewports
all claims bind to exact revisions, target, artifact, and evidence freshness
waiting stages have a durable owner, predicate, retry policy, and next ready stage

developmentRunBinding.authority: existing DevelopmentRun and DevelopmentWorkUnit persisted through worker_jobs and outbox
developmentRunBinding.stageScope: Use stable stage IDs as completedScope and remainingScope values on the owning DevelopmentWorkUnit.
developmentRunBinding.dependencyWaits: Represent blocked stage scopes with registered DevelopmentDependencyContract entries and existing watcher/reconciliation continuation.
developmentRunBinding.artifacts: Store stage output/evidence references on the existing DevelopmentWorkUnit artifacts and validation obligations.
developmentRunBinding.scheduler: Call the dependency-ready selector after each persisted WorkUnit checkpoint; enqueue execution through the existing worker_jobs/outbox path.
developmentRunBinding.prohibited: Do not create a parallel stage database, queue, orchestrator, or finality authority.

completionRule: A Mini App MVP requires manifest, implementation, tests, package, non-production deployment, migration, smoke, UAT, and evidence stages to pass. Factory reuse is reported separately until a second app completes the same pipeline.
